My Arthritis journey

My Knees And Hips Were So Stiff I Could Barely Get Out Of Bed. Then I Discovered This 1,000-Year-Old Japanese Secret...

Robert Martinez

December 19th, 2024 | Health & Pain Relief

I'm 68 years old, and for the last 8 years, I've watched my body slowly break down.

 

It started with my hands—stiffness in the morning that made it hard to open jars or button my shirt. 

Then my knees started aching every time I stood up. Before long, my hips joined the party, making it painful to get in and out of the car.

 

I felt like I was rusting from the inside out.

 

My doctor diagnosed me with osteoarthritis and told me it was "just part of getting older." He prescribed anti-inflammatory pills and said to take it easy.

 

But the pills upset my stomach, and I didn't want to just "take it easy"—I wanted to play with my grandkids, work in my garden, and live my life.

 

Some mornings, the stiffness was so bad I couldn't get out of bed without my wife helping me. I'd limp to the bathroom, my joints screaming with every step.

 

I felt old. Helpless. Like my body had betrayed me.

 

All This Pain Has Almost Ruined My Life!

 

The arthritis affected everything. I couldn't hold my grandson for more than a few minutes because my hands would cramp up. I had to stop volunteering at the community garden because kneeling was too painful. 

 

Even simple things like walking the dog or getting groceries became exhausting.

 

My doctor recommended trying physical therapy, glucosamine supplements, and eventually mentioned that I might need cortisone injections or even joint replacement surgery down the line.

 

Surgery? At my age? I wasn't ready to accept that.

That's When My Neighbor Changed Everything

 

One Saturday morning, my neighbor Tom saw me struggling to get out of my truck. He's 72, a retired construction worker who'd dealt with severe arthritis in his shoulders, back, and knees for over a decade.

 

But lately, I'd noticed something: Tom was moving like a man 20 years younger.

 

He was gardening, washing his own car, even playing catch with his grandson—things I couldn't imagine doing anymore.

 

"Tom," I asked him, "what happened to your arthritis? You're moving like you got a new body."

 

He smiled and said something I'll never forget:

"Bob, I found this Japanese pain patch that my daughter brought back from a trip to Tokyo. It's based on the same minerals they use in those healing hot springs over there. I was skeptical, but after one night, I woke up without that grinding pain in my shoulders. I've been using it for 6 months now—it's changed my life."

 

I was doubtful. A patch? I'd tried those Salonpas things from the pharmacy before—they smelled awful and barely helped for more than an hour or two.

 

But Tom pulled up his shirt and showed me one on his lower back. "It's not like those. This one actually works. Give it a shot—what do you have to lose?"

 

He was right. I had nothing to lose and everything to gain.

That afternoon, I went online and found the Japanese Onsen Pain Patch he was talking about.

 

When It Arrived And I Used It For The First Time, I Couldn't Believe It

 

Three days later, the package arrived.

The patches were individually wrapped and much larger than the drugstore ones I'd tried. The instructions said to apply it to the painful area on clean, dry skin and leave it on for 8-12 hours.

 

I decided to test it on my right knee—the one that hurt the most when I climbed stairs.

I peeled off the backing and pressed the patch over my knee.

 

Within 15 minutes, I felt a gentle, penetrating warmth spreading deep into my joint.

It wasn't a surface-level heat like a heating pad. It felt like the warmth was seeping into the bone itself, loosening up all that stiffness and inflammation.

 

I sat in my recliner, waiting for it to fade like every other remedy I'd tried.

But it didn't fade.

 

After an hour, I stood up to get a glass of water. My knee didn't crack. It didn't scream. I walked to the kitchen without limping.

 

For the first time in months, I climbed the stairs to my bedroom without gripping the railing for dear life.

That night, I slept through without waking up from joint pain.

 

The First Morning I Woke Up Without Stiffness

The next morning, I woke up and swung my legs out of bed—normally, this was when the stiffness hit hardest.

But the patch was still warm, still working, and my knee bent smoothly.

 

No grinding. No hesitation. No pain shooting through my leg.

I walked downstairs, made coffee, and realized I hadn't thought about my knee once.

 

Over the next week, I tried the patches on my hands, my hips, my lower back—every place that ached.

Every single time, I felt that same soothing warmth, followed by blessed relief.

 

After several weeks of using these patches, I can confidently say I feel 15 years younger.

I'm back in the garden. I can pick up my grandson without wincing. My wife and I took a walk around the neighborhood yesterday—something we haven't done together in over a year.

What Makes It So Powerful?

#1 Ancient Japanese Herbal Medicine

This patch is based on traditional Japanese pain remedies that date back over 1,000 years. Japan's oldest medical texts describe wrapping herbal medicines in bamboo strips and applying them to painful joints and muscles.

 

#2 Inspired By Japan's Healing Hot Springs (Onsen)

In Japan, people with arthritis and chronic pain travel to special hot springs called "onsen" to soak in mineral-rich waters. These springs contain sulfur, sodium, calcium sulfate, and other compounds scientifically proven to ease joint inflammation and nerve pain.

 

#3 Natural Warming Action Increases Blood Flow

Unlike plain American menthol patches that just create a cooling tingle on your skin, this Japanese patch also uses a natural capsaicin derivative (from peppers) that:

  • Creates deep, penetrating warmth that reaches into the joint
  • Increases blood circulation to flush out inflammation
  • Delivers oxygen and nutrients to damaged tissue
  • Relieves pressure on inflamed nerves and tendons
  • Supports your body's natural healing process

And it works for 8-12 hours, giving you all-day or all-night relief.

Reduces Pain In Multiple Joints

After 3 months of regular use (I rotate patches between my knees, hands, and lower back), here's what happened:

✅ My knee pain is 80% better – I can climb stairs normally
✅ My hands don't cramp anymore – I can hold my grandson without pain
✅ My hip stiffness is gone – Getting in and out of the car is easy again
✅ I sleep through the night – No more waking up at 4am from aching joints
✅ I stopped taking NSAIDs – No more stomach upset or kidney worries
✅ I feel like I have my life back – Gardening, walking, playing with grandkids

🔥 Feel it: Gentle, penetrating warmth spreads deep into your joints, just soothing relief.

🌿 Breathe it: Natural herbal essence reminiscent of ancient Japanese remedies

🤲 Wear it: The patch molds to your body and stays put for hours without irritation or slipping.
